# The sidebar's groups (sidebar-group = project, Kero's projects). tests/run.sh
# makes two repositories at @DIR@ (alpha, and beta with a src folder) and
# gives this config dir as @CONFIG@; @BIN@ is the app (its CLI too).
size:1100x700
type:cd @DIR@/alpha
key:enter
wait:1.0
# One project, and its header says so (a lone project keeps its name).
expect-group:alpha · 1 tab
expect-group-count:1
tab:here
wait:1.0
# A folder inside a repository is the repository's project.
type:cd @DIR@/beta/src
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-group:beta · 1 tab
expect-group:alpha · 1 tab
expect-group-count:2
# A new tab opens in the focused pane's folder: beta's.
tab:here
wait:1.0
expect-group:beta · 2 tabs
expect-tab-count:3
# Folding a group: only its header, and the tab you're in.
click:Collapse beta
expect-group:beta · 2 tabs · collapsed
expect-shown:2
tab:1
expect-shown:1
# Folded is kept with the window.
roundtrip:go
click:Expand beta
expect-group:beta · 2 tabs
expect-shown:3
# Its + opens a tab in the project's folder (after the tab in front, a
# beta tab: the tabs' own order is alpha, beta, beta, alpha now).
tab:3
click:New Tab in alpha
wait:1.0
expect-group:alpha · 2 tabs
expect-tab-count:4
type:pwd; echo SECOND-ALPHA
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect:@DIR@/alpha
# ⌘2 is the second tab as listed: alpha's second, not the tabs' second.
tab:1
action:goto_tab:2
expect:SECOND-ALPHA
action:next_tab
expect:cd @DIR@/beta/src
tab:1
# A session this Mac's liberttyd keeps that no window shows: a row in its
# project's group; a click shows it in a tab here.
shell:ID=$(@BIN@ +new-session --cwd @DIR@/beta -e 'sleep 600') && @BIN@ +rename-session $ID kept-job
# (The list is read every 4 s.)
wait:4
expect-elsewhere:kept-job
expect-group:beta · 2 tabs · 1 not open here
click-row:kept-job
wait:1.5
expect-tab-count:5
expect-no-elsewhere:kept-job
expect-group:beta · 3 tabs
# A name being typed in place outlives the sessions' list read again
# meanwhile (a session elsewhere more): what's typed after it still goes in.
tab:1
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:renamed-
shell:ID=$(@BIN@ +new-session --cwd @DIR@/beta -e 'sleep 600') && @BIN@ +rename-session $ID during-rename && echo $ID > @CONFIG@/during-rename-id
wait:5
type:tab
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-tab:renamed-tab
expect-elsewhere:during-rename
shell:@BIN@ +kill-session $(cat @CONFIG@/during-rename-id)
wait:4
expect-no-elsewhere:during-rename
# By host: one machine and nothing elsewhere has no header at all.
shell:printf 'sidebar-group = host\n' > @CONFIG@/libertty/config
reload:now
wait:0.5
expect-group:none
expect-shown:5
# Another session no window shows: This Mac gets its header.
shell:ID=$(@BIN@ +new-session --cwd @DIR@/alpha -e 'sleep 600') && @BIN@ +rename-session $ID second-job
# (The list is read every 4 s.)
wait:4
expect-elsewhere:second-job
expect-group:This Mac · 5 tabs · 1 not open here
# Ungrouped: the list as it always was, no sessions elsewhere.
shell:printf 'sidebar-group = none\n' > @CONFIG@/libertty/config
reload:now
wait:0.5
expect-group:none
expect-no-elsewhere:second-job
expect-shown:5
